name: gizza-ai/video-blur-region
summary: Blur or pixelate a fixed rectangular region in a video

tool.description: Blur or pixelate a fixed rectangular region (e.g. a license plate, name tag, or logo) on every frame of a video. Give the region as x/y (top-left offset in pixels) plus width/height in pixels; pick mode = blur (soft Gaussian) or pixelate (coarse mosaic) and a strength of 1-100. Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

mode.description: How to redact the region: "blur" (soft Gaussian) or "pixelate" (coarse mosaic, harder to reverse). Default: blur.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

strength.description: Effect intensity (1-100). For blur it is the Gaussian sigma (higher = softer); for pixelate it is the mosaic block size in pixels (higher = coarser). Default: 20.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

x.description: Left offset of the region in pixels from the top-left corner. Example: 40.

y.description: Top offset of the region in pixels from the top-left corner. Example: 30.
